compare proposed material to source/profile authority and explicit gaps

workflows.name: Reconnect, idempotent recovery and semantic nonvisual operation

recover prior operation result or safe retry choice

resume without duplicate mutation

visual layout cannot carry unique authoritative meaning
reconnected role is reauthorized before cached hidden state is reused
status/current-version lookup precedes retry after ambiguous result
full keyboard operation
screen-reader semantic parity for authorized actions/meaning
